name: Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph (SVDAG)
aliases: Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph (SVDAG) with Common Subtrees Merge (CSM)
definition: A compressed hierarchical data structure for sparse voxel grids that exploits geometric similarity by de-duplicating identical subtrees, transforming the structure from a tree into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) to reduce memory footprint while supporting real-time rendering and interactive editing.
